units.source_text: 我的心情平和了下来，恐怖感也渐渐地减退了。

en.t: My feelings grew calm, and my sense of terror gradually faded.

units.source_text: 对于我来说的所谓美，必须就是这样的东西。

en.t: For me, what was called beauty had to be something like this.

units.source_text: 它从人生中这隔我，又从人生中保护我。

en.t: It separated me from life, and also protected me from life.
